answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by linking each identity to bonded collateral and penalizing correlated equivocation as a group: if k identities coordinate conflicting attestations, aggregate slashing grows as O(k²), not linearly. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, rapidly exhausting shared backing. Thus identities cannot hide behind a thin shale ledge of deposits or disperse risk like a plume.
